graph_policy: native optional graphs enabled; vLLM default compile/graph
candidate_must_win: All predefined cells: lower pooled P50/P95, higher QPS; no failed or skipped requests. Screen cannot accept a change.

diagnostic_plan.purpose: Diagnosis only; do not replace formal benchmark results

hypotheses.prediction: If the C16 deficit depends on sorted workload arrival, changing only permutation will change the P50 gap while outputs remain identical.
If single-executor queueing and prefix/compaction batch exclusions dominate, instrumented short requests will spend most latency queued and exclusive requests will execute alone.
If short requests only lose behind long requests, removing long requests should eliminate the short-only C16 gap; otherwise short-request batching is independently limiting.
If warm-state/drift dominates, original-order C16 will change materially after the diagnostics; compare bracketed repeats.

diagnostic_plan.schedule: formal C1/C8/C16/C32 3 rounds first; reversed/shuffle11/29/47/short-only/long-only C16 each3; short-only C32 each3; original C16 3 bracket repeats
